# Office of the Historian - U.S. Department of State

> The Office of the Historian provides authoritative declassified diplomatic documents, biographical records, and comprehensive foreign relations history spanning U.S. international engagement from the founding era to contemporary times.

This site is the official repository for the Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) series, a comprehensive collection of declassified diplomatic documents. It also maintains extensive biographical directories, country-specific diplomatic histories, and records of high-level diplomatic travel and conferences.

## Key Topics

- Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
- Declassified Documents
- Diplomatic History
- Cold War
- Department of State History
- Secretaries of State
- Presidential Administrations
- Arms Control
- Bilateral Relations
- Historical Records
- Government Transparency
- Diplomatic Conferences
- U.S. Foreign Policy
- International Diplomacy
- Historical Database

## Foreign Relations Documents

- [Historical Documents](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments): Main portal for Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) documents
- [About the Foreign Relations Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/about-frus): Overview and guidelines for FRUS series publication and access
- [Status of the Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/status-of-the-series): Current publication status and declassification updates for FRUS
- [History of the Foreign Relations Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus-history): Historical overview of FRUS series development and archival practices
- [Quarterly Releases](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/quarterly-releases): Schedule and archive of quarterly digitized historical document releases
- [Ebooks](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/ebooks): FRUS ebooks in EPUB and Mobi formats for digital access

## Biographical & Personnel Records

- [Biographies of the Secretaries of State](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/people/secretaries): Biographical directory of all U.S. Secretaries of State
- [Principal Officers and Chiefs of Mission](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/people/principals-chiefs): Database of State Department principal officers and diplomatic chiefs

## Bilateral Relations & Countries

- [Countries](https://history.state.gov/countries): Directory of U.S. bilateral relations and diplomatic history by country
- [Archives](https://history.state.gov/countries/archives): Guide to international diplomatic archives and research resources

## Diplomatic Travel & Conferences

- [Travels of the President](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/travels/president): Database of U.S. Presidential foreign trips and diplomatic visits
- [Travels of the Secretary](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/travels/secretary): Historical record of Secretary of State foreign diplomatic travels
- [Visits by Foreign Leaders](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/visits): Historical record of foreign leader visits to the United States
- [Conferences](https://history.state.gov/conferences): Historical record of major diplomatic conferences and negotiations

## Department History

- [World War I and the Department](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/wwi): State Department role and operations during World War I
- [U.S. Diplomatic Couriers](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/diplomatic-couriers): History and operations of the U.S. Diplomatic Courier Service
- [Buildings](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/buildings): Historical timeline of State Department building locations

## Research Tools & Navigation

- [Tags](https://history.state.gov/tags): Subject taxonomy and browsable index for foreign relations topics
- [Latest News](https://history.state.gov): Homepage for Office of the Historian with latest news and updates
